description: Land Aquisition - Gangodawila, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District, Land Aquisition - Correction Paper, Ex. Gazette No. 2420/51 dated 22.01.2025 Sec.39 (a)(1)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters, specifically describing land parcels, their boundaries, measurements, and registration details for various plots in the Gampaha District. It references the Land Acquisition Act and contains detailed technical descriptions of land parcels with survey numbers, boundaries, and measurements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
